encounter: E0184 TRAINER_DARRIN (Route107, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 107 is reached by Surf from Dewford after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json - New Mauville entrance and interior via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Thwackey line (36), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), Sneasel (14) - so all source maps precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Darrin is a complete rain architecture: a Damp Rock Politoed that supports rather than attacks, three Swift Swim abusers at different speeds behind it, a Levitate Rotom-Wash and Mega Gyarados as the closer. Two facts decide the fight. First, Darrin's six carry no Ground, Fire or Fighting move at all, which makes an Assault Vest Magnezone close to unkillable here - Steel resists Grass, Ice, Dragon and Flying, Electric is resisted outright, and only neutral Water gets through - while its Thunderbolt is 2x on four members and 4x on Mega Gyarados. Second, the honest answer to Swift Swim is not out-speeding it but ignoring speed entirely: Rillaboom's Grassy Glide and Weavile's Ice Shard are priority, and Iron Hands' Fake Out denies a doubled-Speed turn outright. Gengar's Taunt is pointed at Politoed, whose Helping Hand, Icy Wind and Protect are what turn the setter into a support piece. Grass and Electric between them are super effective on every single member.
